description_html:
Key Features

  • High-Capacity Drying Chamber: 466-litre volume accommodates large batches, ideal for industrial and commercial drying needs.
  • Efficient Moisture Removal: Removes up to 206 kilograms of moisture per day, supporting rapid and effective drying cycles.
  • Consistent High-Temperature Operation: Maintains a stable air temperature of 70°C, ensuring thorough and uniform drying results.
  • Batch Drying Capability: Supports batch drying with a cycle duration of 77 hours, suitable for processes requiring extended drying times.
  • Through-Flow Airflow Pattern: Optimized airflow design ensures even distribution of heated air throughout the chamber, reducing drying inconsistencies.
  • Enthalpy-Wheel Conditioning Technology: Advanced enthalpy-wheel system enhances energy efficiency and humidity control during operation.

Main Benefits

  • Maximized Productivity: Large chamber size and high moisture removal rate streamline drying operations, reducing downtime between batches.
  • Energy Efficiency: The enthalpy-wheel conditioning system minimizes energy consumption while maintaining effective humidity management.
  • Reliable Performance: Precise temperature control and uniform airflow ensure consistent results, minimizing the risk of under- or over-drying.
  • Flexible Application: Suitable for a wide range of drying needs, from food processing to pharmaceuticals and material conditioning.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Industrial Batch Drying: Ideal for manufacturers needing to dry bulk materials, ingredients, or products in controlled environments.
  • Moisture Control in Production: Helps maintain product quality and shelf life by efficiently removing excess moisture.
  • Laboratory and Research Applications: Supports experimental drying processes that require precise temperature and humidity settings.
  • Customizable Pricing: Unit price is determined post-acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific project requirements.

Frequently Asked User Questions Addressed

  • Is the unit suitable for large-scale drying? Yes, the 466-litre chamber and high moisture removal rate support industrial-scale operations.
  • How consistent is the drying process? The through-flow airflow and stable temperature ensure even and reliable drying throughout each batch.
  • What about energy usage? The enthalpy-wheel technology is designed for energy-efficient performance, reducing operational costs.
  • How is the unit priced? Pricing is provided upon acceptance, allowing for customization based on unique needs and configurations.
